source_policy: Mathematical construction uses admitted exact editions; human sources retain their own rights. Independently written exposition, truthful attribution and complete prerequisite proofs are required.

proof_companions.title: Proof companion: bounded topology and faithful states
proof_companions.prerequisite_notice: Complete selected earlier programme arguments for the bounded representation and faithful-state branch, at the stated scalar, Hilbert and set-theoretic entry assumptions. General weights, modular theory and the whole course are not certified.

proof_companions.title: Proof companion: normal functionals and tracial representations
proof_companions.prerequisite_notice: Positive-functional normality, arbitrary projection joins and exact threshold cuts, with arbitrary directed nets and Hilbert cardinality. The companion identifies the earlier programme proofs and their assumptions. Full course-wide transitive review remains unfinished.

proof_companions.title: Proof companion: normal tensor tests and tracial products
proof_companions.prerequisite_notice: Normal product functionals at arbitrary Hilbert cardinality; faithful countable tracial products and compatible GNS identifications; normal tensor homomorphisms with exact kernels and ranges; normal completely positive dilations and tensor maps, and predual limits of tensor automorphisms.

proof_companions.title: Proof companion: removing a discrete trace-scaling cocycle
proof_companions.prerequisite_notice: The discrete counting and Fourier argument treats every specified unitary in a semifinite algebra with separable predual, including nonfactors. Trace existence and central averaging supplies T1. The extended-positive and spectral, density and modular-transfer inputs W1–W3 are stated separately.

proof_companions.title: Proof companion: dual fixed points, core commutants and central cocycles
proof_companions.prerequisite_notice: Full supplied proofs retain arbitrary-algebra scope, the specified cocycle and every faithful-state chart. The general standard-form, KMS, dual-weight conjugation, core-chart, spectral and harmonic-analysis inputs remain explicit; no complete transitive certificate is claimed.

proof_companions.title: Trace existence and central averaging
proof_companions.prerequisite_notice: Finite center-valued traces, normal corner-trace extension, semifinite scalar traces and simultaneous norm averaging, with arbitrary centers, Hilbert dimensions and increasing nets. The accompanying bounded-topology and tracial-normality proofs supply the stated analytic foundations.

proof_companions.title: Crossed-product recognition and injective cores
proof_companions.prerequisite_notice: Crossed-product recognition, corners, trace normalization, factorial-centralizer spectra and the injective type III-lambda reduction. PC9–PC11 prove norm-one retractions, invariant-state finite classification and its tracial foundations. TF2–TF3 and TF5–TF6 supply the tracial product identification and general normal tensor maps. Modular-weight, bidual and standard-pair foundations retain their stated scope.

trace_foundations.scope: Finite center-valued traces, normal corner-trace extension, semifinite scalar traces and simultaneous norm averaging, with arbitrary centers, Hilbert dimensions and increasing nets. The accompanying bounded-topology and tracial-normality proofs supply the stated analytic foundations.

powers_factor_scope.scope: The product construction, modular eigenbasis, factorial centralizer, diagonal expectation and flip action are developed here. The companion proves crossed-product recognition, factorial-centralizer spectra, norm-one projections, invariant-state finite classification and its tracial quotient and expectation foundations. The modular, standard-pair, bidual, tensor and trace-scaling foundations retain their stated scope.

tensor_foundations.scope: Normal product functionals at arbitrary Hilbert cardinality; faithful countable tracial products and compatible GNS identifications; normal tensor homomorphisms with exact kernels and ranges; normal completely positive dilations and tensor maps, and predual limits of tensor automorphisms.

discrete_stability.scope: The discrete counting and Fourier argument treats every specified unitary in a semifinite algebra with separable predual, including nonfactors. Trace existence and central averaging supplies T1. The extended-positive and spectral, density and modular-transfer inputs W1–W3 are stated separately.

core_foundations.scope: Full supplied proofs retain arbitrary-algebra scope, the specified cocycle and every faithful-state chart. The general standard-form, KMS, dual-weight conjugation, core-chart, spectral and harmonic-analysis inputs remain explicit; no complete transitive certificate is claimed.

tracial_foundations_scope: Complete general positive-functional order-normality/ultraweak equivalence, arbitrary projection joins and exact half-closed threshold construction, with the entire used weight, convexity, predual and bounded-calculus proof chain supplied. Applies to the full existing semifinite tracial theorem; broader Borel, modular and classification work remains explicit.

normal_tensor_scope.scope: Normal product functionals at arbitrary Hilbert cardinality; faithful countable tracial products and compatible GNS identifications; normal tensor homomorphisms with exact kernels and ranges; normal completely positive dilations and tensor maps, and predual limits of tensor automorphisms.

periodic_state_subfactor.scope: The construction preserves the specified periodic state and its complete modular action on an arbitrary separable type III-lambda ambient factor. The periodic-state, corner and normal-GNS proofs are linked explicitly. General modular and spectral foundations retain their stated hypotheses; full transitive programme review remains unfinished.

scope: Finite-partition reindexing preserves every trace and specified covariance norm for arbitrary induced countable-group actions. Weighted errors and the fixed-cocycle diagonal give a conditional cohomology criterion. The Gaussian projection theorem supplies that criterion for faithful induced countable amenable actions; foundational transitive review remains unfinished.

Relative coefficient-intertwiner freeness for every nontrivial induced countable-group element; finite-group unitary cocycle correction in an arbitrary finite coefficient commutant with its faithful invariant trace. The central trace comparison and crossed-product proofs are included. General analytic transitive review remains unfinished.

full_comparison_scope: Bounded passage and construction comparisons do not certify all source dependencies, complete structural independence or the full transitive proof chain. Whole-scope certification remains unfinished for every selected lesson.

characteristic_approximation.scope: Simultaneous approximation of trace-preserving comparison automorphisms and prescribed compatible cocycles for countable amenable actions on the hyperfinite semifinite factor. The arbitrary-factor conditional theorem and abelian character correction retain full scope. Fixed-ultrafilter and moving-multiplier arguments are explicit; complete transitive analytic review remains unfinished.

finite_trace_provider.scope: Normalized faithful normal center-valued trace for every finite von Neumann algebra; faithful scalar trace on countably decomposable central pieces; arbitrary central assembly.

finite_action_foundations.retained_alternative: Sections 14–15 give the affine-isometry fixed-point and support/faithfulness arguments.
finite_action_foundations.separate_prerequisites: General standard form, natural cones and their modular prerequisites.

projection_foundations.proof_scope: Simultaneous Gram correction, factorial corollary, three examples and four solutions at arbitrary von Neumann algebra and Hilbert-space scope.
projection_foundations.entry_assumptions: Complete real and complex scalars, inner-product axioms and finite-dimensional algebra.

earlier_programme_provider.scope: Foundation A in full; GP0 opening four paragraphs through bounded adjoints and the norm-square identity.

projection_foundations.local_proofs: H2 finite sums and matrix corners; H3 norm series; coefficient recurrence in Section1.
projection_foundations.transitive_programme_proof_status: Supplied and checked at these stated entry assumptions.
projection_foundations.source_comparison_scope: Complete lesson compared with the assigned projection statements and proofs in Connes1975,Lemma1.2.6,and TakesakiIII,XVII.1.7. This is the recorded construction-source scope; no universal originality or independent human-review claim.

isotropy_gluing.scope: Gluing of actual phase-compatible isotropy comparisons over a supplied finite Borel exhaustion. The unitary cocycle, trace gauge and chosen inner implementers are retained. Predual completeness and finite gluing are proved here; initial isotropy classification, construction of compatible phases and full transitive review remain separate.

scope: Characteristic models for countable amenable groups with prescribed actual multiplication and transport phases, exact inner subgroup and arbitrary permitted trace modulus. Borel field transport uses supplied enumerations and a multiplicative principal section. General initial comparison, universal defect realization, fixed-factor Borel trivialization and full transitive review remain separate.

Explicit inverse-character and coherent trace corrections of supplied genuine isotropy comparisons, preserving chosen inner implementers and a prescribed positive trace gauge. Full Borel cochain witnesses and the existing gluing hypotheses are retained. Initial amenable comparison, field trivialization and full transitive review remain separate.

reading_links.scope: The cited Connes1974 and Connes–Størmer1978 journal articles are available as complete scans through the Denise Vella Chemla bibliography. These are third-party reading links; the article PDFs are not included in this course.

Homogeneity of the state space of factors of type III1

scope: Exact scalar correction on a supplied increasing finite Borel relation, including descent from matched inner isotropy. General initial comparison and outer isotropy have separate scope; full source and transitive prerequisite review remains incomplete.

Unitary correction on principal relations and the asymptotic centralizer, with pointwise approximate comparison on the original factor. Exact original-factor cocycles are supplied by the subsequent near-identity lesson. Full source and transitive prerequisite review remains incomplete.

Exact unitary lifts for finite or countably decomposable infinite semifinite factors, controlled finite coboundaries and finite inner comparisons. Convergent two-sided conjugacy has separate scope; full source and transitive prerequisite review remains incomplete.

Quantitative two-cocycle correction inside a finite or countably decomposable infinite semifinite factor, exact coordinate cocycles and genuine approximate comparisons, under the stated induced-action and foundational hypotheses. Full source and transitive prerequisite review remains incomplete.

Two-sided convergence of automorphisms and transported cocycles, including the one-sided shift obstruction. Full source, distinctive-organization and transitive prerequisite review remains incomplete.

Uniform tower correction and genuine cocycle stabilization for finite or countably decomposable infinite semifinite factors, with separate nontracial state estimates. Full source, distinctive-organization and transitive prerequisite review remains incomplete.

Generator and prefix-functional tests for finite cocycle stabilization, with quotient and original-factor laws distinguished. Full source, distinctive-organization and transitive prerequisite review remains incomplete.

The classical alternating comparison for centrally nontrivial amenable actions on finite or countably decomposable infinite semifinite factors, under the stated foundations. Nontrivial inner isotropy and measured-field classification have additional scope. Full source, distinctive-organization and transitive prerequisite review remains incomplete.

finite_orbit_class_towers.scope: A complete direct deduction of finite towers from a free probability-preserving hyperfinite orbit relation, retaining the exact programme hyperfiniteness prerequisite and its foundations. Both the finite-relation and descending-packing routes remain available.

scope: Approximate original-factor comparisons and a genuine ultrapower cocycle with prescribed inner-subgroup values.
The quotient scalar associator, exact reconstruction, a common-coboundary comparison and the approximate joint input for general associators.
Simultaneous comparison of quotient maps and actual coefficients with a common scalar associator, followed by a genuine full-group cocycle.
Completed-measure selection, invariant Borel reduction and exact gluing on a supplied constant hyperfinite semifinite field with a finite orbit exhaustion.
Countable semifinite action classification and measured constant-field comparison from the full moving characteristic class and compatible trace multiplier.
Exact reconstruction from labelled return arrows for varying separable factor fields, with semifinite characteristic comparison and trace normalization under the stated foundations.
The global characteristic criterion for integer–real actions, including properly ergodic, free transitive and periodic transitive centres, under the stated factor and measured-relation foundations.

trace_scaling_comparison_scope.scope: Trace-normalized comparison of two real actions with the same properly ergodic centre flow, exact scalar-phase correction and a spatial crossed-product isomorphism; the type III-zero application retains its stated core, uniformity and foundational prerequisites. Full source, expression/organization and transitive prerequisite review remains incomplete.

finite_covering_proof.scope: Finite-cover averaging and greedy disjoint retention, and the exact incoming-boundary coverage inequality for measurable packing. The older tower announcement is distinguished from a supplied full tower proof.

skew_odometer_scope.scope: Five-digit realization of a prescribed properly ergodic real flow, its invariant coordinate, compatible matrix approximation and abelian crossed-product model; seven solved exercises. Full source ancestry, expression/organization and transitive prerequisite review remains incomplete, including exact access for the historical Hewitt–Savage reference.

module_kernel_scope.scope: The module kernel for approximately finite type III-zero factors: nonfactor coefficient approximation, central coboundaries, return normalization and canonical-extension continuity; eight solved exercises. Full source ancestry, expression/organization and transitive prerequisite review remains incomplete.

module_splitting_scope.scope: Continuous homomorphic sections of the module map for approximately finite type III-zero factors, derivative compensation, real crossed-product duality and a Pell central-unitary example; eight solved exercises. Full source ancestry, expression/organization and transitive prerequisite review remains incomplete.

common_gauge_scope.scope: Common-gauge invariants for automorphisms of approximately finite type III-zero factors, the exact kernel of the separate-class projection, a realized sign obstruction and conditional outer-conjugacy classification with normal crossed-product descent; eight solved exercises. Full source ancestry, expression/organization and transitive prerequisite review remains incomplete.

full_group_criterion.scope: Proposition 2.A: full-group membership is equivalent to fixing every bounded asymptotically invariant sequence for an arbitrary nonsingular aperiodic transformation. The proof constructs finite marker intervals, uses a finite two-colour average and proves the converse by truncating a measurable integer displacement.
full_group_criterion.remaining: Whole source ancestry, distinctive expression and teaching organization, and transitive programme foundations remain under review. The constant-field comparison belongs to the retained conditional alternative; the main equality proof uses the variable field.
full_group_criterion.base_implementation: Corollary 2.B: once the coefficient algebra is preserved, its centre action is implemented by the strong-star unitary sum of orbit partial isometries, giving an inner perturbation trivial on the centre.

contracting_cocycle_scope.scope: Proposition2.C and Corollary2.D: a specified cocycle for the varying central return density is transported to the real suspension and removed by one unitary in the original coefficient algebra. The inner correction fixes the integer implementer and commutes with the return automorphism.
contracting_cocycle_scope.remaining: Whole source ancestry, distinctive expression and teaching organization, and transitive programme foundations remain under review. The constant-field comparison belongs to the retained conditional alternative; the main equality proof uses the variable field.

lacunary_corner_scope.scope: Proposition2.E compares two possibly distinct centralizer cuts by full normal inverse maps. Proposition2.F transports a matched cut, with its explicit extra hypothesis, to a lacunary centralizer preserved by an inner perturbation.
lacunary_corner_scope.remaining: Whole source ancestry, distinctive expression and teaching organization, and transitive programme foundations remain under review. The constant-field comparison belongs to the retained conditional alternative; the main equality proof uses the variable field.

matched_corner_scope.scope: Central triviality forces the partial center isomorphism to follow the return orbits. Its full coefficient-corner implementer gives the matched cut and hence the lacunary normalization.
matched_corner_scope.remaining: Whole source ancestry, distinctive expression and teaching organization, and transitive programme foundations remain under review. The constant-field comparison belongs to the retained conditional alternative; the main equality proof uses the variable field.

variable_field_scope.scope: Countable phase tests, a globally assembled coefficient sequence, the nonsingular height-n tower and measurable selection prove innerness of the whole coefficient action. The main core-normalizer equality then follows from the explicit slab implementer at the stated foundations.
variable_field_scope.remaining: Whole source ancestry, distinctive expression and teaching organization, and transitive programme foundations remain under review. The constant-field comparison belongs to the retained conditional alternative; the main equality proof uses the variable field.

periodic_cocycle_scope.scope: Periodic cocycles, their explicit core realizers, all six characteristic-square kernels, cyclic return phases and the tensor modular-action calculation; seven solved exercises. Core analytic proofs are included at their stated foundations. The classification consequence additionally requires the separate modular cyclic-return comparison. Full source, organization and transitive prerequisite checks remain unfinished.
periodic_cocycle_scope.source_ancestry: Takesaki II XII.6.15–6.17 and III XVIII.1.14, Exercises XVIII.1.1 and1.4; KST1992 Lemma18 through the earlier centrally trivial converse.
periodic_cocycle_scope.unresolved: Transitive analytic and classification foundations; whole-source ancestry and distinctive organization checks for the entire inherited chain.
